title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you trying to do**

The use case this would unblock, not just the feature itself.

**What you're proposing**

A new route, a new parameter on an existing one, a new example, an SDK addition — be as concrete as you can.

**Note**

This repository covers the public API's documentation and examples. Requests that require changes to data
collection, parsing, or the underlying model are still welcome here as an issue, but will need to be picked up
in the (private) backend before anything can ship.
